name: Nunatak: Temple of Ice

categories.label: Points scored during play
categories.hint: 2x2 square majority (most blocks 5, second 2), 1 point per own supporting block, outer-edge bonus (7 to the player with most blocks on the outer tiles per one source).

categories.label: Builders (purple)
categories.hint: Majority scoring: most Builders gets a large bonus (20 per sources), others a smaller per-card score; enter the points from the rulebook table.

categories.label: Sculptors (blue)
categories.hint: Value rises with number collected; enter points from the scoring table.

categories.label: Artisans (teal)
categories.hint: Set scoring on matching/complete tool icons; enter points.

categories.label: Beasts of Burden (brown)
categories.hint: Cards x beast symbols on them.

categories.label: Architects (yellow)
categories.hint: Number of Architect cards x your level on the Architect track.

categories.label: Elders (orange)
categories.hint: Points from symbols/other card types per each Elder card; enter total.

categories.label: Full-set and Blessing bonus
categories.labelVi: Thưởng bộ đủ và thẻ Blessing
categories.hint: Bonus for completing sets of all six card types plus unused Blessing cards; enter points.

tiebreakers.description: Not verified; no overall tiebreaker found.

notes: family: area-majority. NOT verified against the official rulebook (T&K PDF and BGG files not retrievable). Only the square majority (5/2), support point (1 each), Beasts and Architects formulas are consistent across reviews; Builders (20 for most, tie value unclear), Sculptors, Artisans, Elders values, edge bonus, set bonus and game-end trigger remain unconfirmed and are scorer inputs. Solo (1 player) mode not modelled.
